name: Environment Programme
summary: Oak Foundation's environment grants for people-centred conservation and landscape restoration, including regenerative agriculture and rewilding in Southern Africa. Not-for-profits not invited by a programme officer can send an unsolicited letter of enquiry; full applications are by invitation.
